comment: 31yo female with lifelong platelet count 95-110 x10⁹/L (presumed ITP for 15 years, refractory to treatment), referred for hereditary-thrombocytopenia evaluation when her 8yo nephew was diagnosed with T-cell ALL. ETV6 / ANKRD26 / RUNX1 targeted germline panel returned positive for RUNX1 c.611G>A (p.Arg204Gln, runt-domain missense, established pathogenic in FPD/AML kindreds). FPD/AML clinical criteria (lifelong moderate thrombocytopenia + abnormal platelet aggregation on dense-granule release study + family history of T-ALL in nephew + RUNX1-positive panel) all met. Cascade testing already in motion for siblings + her two children. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = RUNX1 carrier surveillance — CBC + smear q3-6mo lifelong, baseline BMA + myeloid NGS within 6-12mo, annual bleeding-history + medication review, structured perioperative bleeding plan, cascade germline testing + buccal-confirmation for siblings + children, mandatory donor-germline-screening before any sibling HSC use; alternative = intensified track with q3-month CBC, scheduled BMA every 1-2 years, pre-emptive HLA-typing of sibling cohort + germline-testing of all candidates, pre-emptive consultation with hereditary-myeloid-program transplant team, multidisciplinary obstetric-hematology plan if she pursues another pregnancy.
